items.docs:
List users with saved browser sessions for the organization.

Each user has ONE unified context that may contain auth for multiple domains.
Admins can see all users' sessions, members can only see their own.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain to revoke auth for. If not provided, clears ALL auth.

items.docs:
Delete a user's saved authentication.

- If domain is provided: Surgically removes auth for that specific domain
  (starts a Kernel browser session to filter cookies, then persists)
- If domain is not provided: Clears ALL auth by deleting the unified context

Users can delete their own session. Admins can delete any user's session.
